landing.title: Garage Talk
landing.subtitle: Manhajin Zamantakewa tare da Tattaunawa da Watsa Kai Tsaye
landing.description: Mafi kyawun dandali don masu gyaran motoci. Samu taimakon bincike nan take daga Gearhead Agent, kalli koyarwar ƙwararru, kuma ku yi haɗin gwiwa a ɗakunan tattaunawa na ainihi.
landing.badge: Yanzu tare da Gearhead Agent Diagnostics
landing.scanQR: Duba lambar QR don shigar da Garage Talk a wayarka
landing.worksOnBoth: Yana aiki a Android da iOS. Ƙara zuwa Shafin Gida don mafi kyawun ƙwarewa.
landing.featuresTitle: Komai Da Kuke Bukata Don Bincika da Gyara
landing.featuresDescription: Garage Talk yana haɗa koyon bidiyo, binciken Gearhead Agent, da goyon bayan al'umma a wuri ɗaya mai ƙarfi.
landing.threeSteps: Fara cikin matakai uku masu sauƙi
landing.step1Description: Yi amfani da Gearhead Agent don bayyana matsalolin injin cikin Turanci kamar "Engine na bugun a idle akan Chevy 350"
landing.step2Description: Samu bidiyoyin koyarwa masu dacewa da jagororin gyara mataki-mataki
landing.step3Description: Haɗa tare da sauran masu gyaran motoci a ɗakunan tattaunawa na ainihi don warware matsaloli tare
landing.pricingDescription: Fara kyauta kuma ku haɓaka yayin da kuke girma. Duk shirye-shiryen da aka biya sun haɗa da raba riba.
landing.forActiveMechanics: Ga masu gyaran motoci masu aiki
landing.viewAllPlanDetails: Duba duk cikakkun bayanai da fasaloli
landing.ctaTitle: Kun Shirya Don Gyara Ƙarin Motoci?
landing.ctaDescription: Ku shiga dubban masu gyaran motoci waɗanda suke amfani da Garage Talk don gano matsaloli cikin sauri da raba ƙwarewarsu.
